# {{.Lang}} Coding Rules: Digest

The decisions of the {{.Lang}} coding rules that set the shape of code as you write it.
Import this file from `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md`. For the examples and the detail of
each rule, read [the full handbook]({{handbookPath}}).

## Mindset

- {{maximName "Tell, don't ask"}}
- {{maximName "Make illegal states unrepresentable"}}
- {{maximName "Parse, don't validate"}}
- {{maximName "Every indirection must earn its keep"}}
- {{maximName "Duplication is far cheaper than the wrong abstraction"}}
- {{maximName "Three strikes and you refactor"}}
- {{maximName "If a test is hard to write, the design is wrong"}}
- {{maximName "Clear is better than clever"}}
- {{maximName "When in Rome, code as the Romans do"}}
